releases.name: Backyard Baseball
releases.summary: The timeless classic is leveling up with all-new game modes, new ways to play, brand-new features and more. It’s the game you love, reimagined for a whole new era. Get ready for Backyard Baseball like you've never experienced it before.

releases.name: The Sinking City 2
releases.summary:
The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension. 

* Immerse yourself in a distinct atmosphere of cosmic horror and twisted designs drawn from the dark wellsprings of HP Lovecraft's macabre imagination. 
* Explore and survive the city of Arkham, a sprawling labyrinth of flooded alleys and decrepit mansions where eldritch horrors lurk just out of sight. 
* Use an arsenal of weapons to fight off Deep Ones, Mi-gos, occult zealots, and other iconic monsters from the source material as well as new and unique creatures that expand the Cthulhu Mythos. 
* Experience the classic survival horror formula at its finest, complete with inventory management, optional puzzles, and backtracking to newly unlocked areas and hidden treasures. 
* Use environmental storytelling and scattered clues to solve side mysteries that unlock new outcomes and gameplay bonuses.  
* Thanks to Unreal Engine 5, The Sinking City 2 delivers next-gen visuals with Lumen global illumination, photorealistic Nanite geometry, life-like Metahuman-powered characters, and much more.

releases.name: Starsand Island
releases.summary:
This Killer Deck has won tournaments and has crushed hundreds of opponents. You have to check this Killer Deck out for yourself, and see if you can build a deck just like it. Then, check and test it with the people you duel with, Improve your Skills, Learn the Game and become a Master Duelist!


-A Killer Deck contains, strong four-star monsters
-A way to summon tribute monsters without having to tribute
-A way to draw extra cards
-40 cards in your deck ,and no more
-Cards the let you search your deck for other cards
-Creatures that summon other creatures when their destroyed
-Cards that can wipe out your opponent's monsters, traps, spells and fusion cards.

With the correct combination of monster, traps, spells and fusion cards you can make your own Killer Deck unbeatable.

releases.name: The Long Survival
releases.summary:
A Long Survive is a cooperative shooter game focused on survival against waves of varied enemies. It is an intense action game with resource management, real-time strategy and building elements. 

In A Long Survive, you will take on the role of a soldier from Space Corp. You will have to go with your team to one of the extraction bases on the new planets taken by humans. But obviously, it won't be easy. These extraction bases are besieged by the Lerp army. You will have to survive their waves as long as you can while protecting the nexus.

Will you be able to complete the mission? Or will you have to escape?

releases.name: Black Flower
releases.summary: In this strategic roguelike survival game, knowledge is your true progression. Grow flowers, gather resources, and use clever combinations of tools, devices, charms and weather to make the Black Flower bloom.

releases.name: NeoNoid
releases.summary: Take control of the NeoNoid and master the ultimate brick-breaking challenge!Bounce the ball, destroy bricks, defeat enemies, and clear all 20 challenging levels. Keep the ball in play, use the Magnet power to attract and control the ball, and master your timing and skills to overcome increasingly difficult challenges.Can you become a true NeoNoid Master?

releases.name: Lingix Lingo
releases.summary:
※本作は日本語に対応しておりません。
脳トレーナーと語学愛好家のためにデザインされた究極のワード パズル体験へようこそ!伝統的な Lingo スタイルの単語ゲームからインスピレーションを得たこのタイトルでは、色分けされた戦略的なヒントを使用して、時間のプレッシャーの下で隠された単語を推測することが求められます。

緑色は、文字が正しく、完璧な位置にあることを意味します。黄色は、文字が単語内にあるものの、間違った位置にあることを意味します。論理を駆使してパワーアップのロックを解除し、スコアボードを登りましょう!

主な特徴:
スリル満点のストリーク モード: あなたのスキルで究極のテストに挑戦してください!絶え間なく続く言葉の集中砲火に直面してください。単語の長さが変化し、テーマがランダム化されているため、連鎖を断ち切るまでに連続して何単語解くことができるでしょうか?

多様な単語の長さ: 4 文字、5 文字、6 文字の単語を特徴とするダイナミック モードをプレイして、徐々に難易度を上げていきます。

豊富なカテゴリ マップ: インタラクティブな進行マップを探索します。一般知識、科学、芸術、言語、文学、建築、心理学などの専用カテゴリで語彙力をテストします。

強力なブースター: 難しい言葉に行き詰まっていませんか?苦労して稼いだコインを使って、ボム（間違った文字を排除する）やタイムエクステンダーなどの強力なパワーアップをアクティブにして、時計の針を動かし続けます。

魅力的な進行: スコア倍率を獲得し、数千枚のコインを集め、完璧な 3 つ星の評価でステージをクリアして、単語の習得を証明します。

Nintendo Switch™ の完全サポート: TV モードの大画面、卓上、または携帯モードの完全な最適化により外出先でも快適にプレイできます。

5 分間の簡単な頭の体操、高度な語彙の徹底的な学習、またはストリーク モードでの一か八かのランを希望する場合でも、このゲームは教育的で中毒性のあるパズルの楽しみを無限に提供します。知恵を磨き、語彙を増やして、今すぐ究極の単語チャンピオンになりましょう!

releases.name: BraveDungeon: The Meaning of Justice
releases.summary: ◆What Is the “The Legend of Dark Witch” Series?The first game in The Legend of Dark Witch series was developed by the Japanese indie studio INSIDE SYSTEM and released as a downloadable title in 2014. The series has sold more than 500,000 copies worldwide.◆What Is “Brave Dungeon”?Brave Dungeon is a spin-off of The Legend of Dark Witch series. The game has sold more than 100,000 copies worldwide.●OverviewThis sequel retains the core gameplay systems of the original Brave Dungeon while introducing three distinct stories, each featuring a different protagonist and its own unique gameplay system.-Al:Explore the vast Forest of Miracles and find your way out. Collect a limited number of “GrassKeys” to unlock the countless “IvyDoors” blocking your path.You can expand the areas available for exploration by collecting pieces of Syega scattered throughout the forest and using them to create “Seama Items.”-Klinsy:Your goal is to find the “Unsealing Books” hidden within the three library towers known as the “Unopened Archives.”The libraries are filled with “Sealing Traps” designed to test the wisdom of anyone who enters.-Papelne:Papelne finds herself in the middle of an empty plain and begins building a city from scratch. Gather materials and use them to craft new tools, facilities, and decorative objects.You are free to build and decorate the city however you like. Create a more attractive city and welcome even more visitors!

releases.name: Akatori
releases.summary:
Akatori is a metroidvania/slasher platformer with a charming pixel-art and a captivating story. You're going to follow the young girl Mako that starts a fascinating adventure to save her world from destruction.

Dive into magical worlds of Aarkalia, uncover its secrets and stop the ancient God awakening ritual.

releases.name: Karakulo 21
releases.summary: You've been recruited by ChocoShit S.A. to pay off your debt in the "KK" Program. Open thousands of chocolate bars, feed the insatiable KaraKulo, and pray for the Golden Ticket that will earn your freedom. Upgrade, survive corporate exploitation, and keep working!

releases.name: Grave Seasons
releases.summary:
Build your farm, fish and mine, and explore the unknowns of a strange, ancient town all while romancing the secretive local townsfolk. Just make sure you stop the supernatural murders before it’s too late… 

What happens when you blend an unnatural serial killer with a idyllic, isolated mountain town? 

You escaped jail and managed to make it to Ashenridge, but at what cost? Build your farm, fish and mine, and explore the unknowns of a strange, ancient town all while romancing the secretive local townsfolk. Just make sure you stop the supernatural murders before it’s too late… in GRAVE SEASONS, an all-new murder mystery farming sim RPG!

releases.name: Tower Dominion
releases.summary:
Your empire faces relentless invasions from the savage Artronids, threatening its very existence. As Commander, you are the last line of defense against the deadly enemy onslaught.

Survival depends on constant innovation and adaptation. Every alien wave is a unique combination of Artronids that will test your ability to adapt.

Are you ready to employ innovative tactics, build impregnable defenses and hold the line? Commander, your troops await your orders!

releases.name: Busy Bar - World Tour
releases.summary: Serve drinks, survive ridiculous guests, upgrade your bars, and buy out rival moguls — solo or in co-op — in a chill bar empire game where every shift ends in progress.

releases.name: Island Farmer
releases.summary: Arrange the farm islands and see your archipelago expand. Just swap the blocks of a 3D jigsaw puzzle.

releases.name: Hit N Slash VR
releases.summary: Step into a mesmerizing abstract universe in hitNslash VR, a relaxing yet fast-paced action experience designed for virtual reality.Equipped with two unique weapons the Slasher and the Smasher you must react quickly as obstacles appear in your path. Slice through fragile objects, smash heavy blocks, and keep moving forward in an endless procedural world.Every run generates a new path filled with obstacles, pickups, and surprises across five visually distinct biomes. With chill electronic music, vibrant neon environments, and intuitive VR gameplay, HitNslash VR creates a satisfying rhythm of destruction and flow.Break through obstacles.Slice with precision.Survive as long as you can.How far can you go in the infinite world of hitNslash VR?

releases.name: Aether Keepers
releases.summary: Protect the core! Don't let the demons eat it! Welcome to this addictive incremental tower defense challenge. Build and upgrade your army in real-time to get stronger and stronger. Create your invincible legion—All units move out!

releases.name: Mafia: The Old Country - Man of Honor
releases.summary:
Sicily – Winter, 1905. In the months since his initiation, Enzo Favara has proven himself a reliable soldier of the Torrisi crime family. Now the Don entrusts him and Cesare with a delicate assignment: assist Ennio Salieri, a man of honor recently released from prison and intent on reclaiming what is his.

At Salieri's side, Enzo is drawn deeper into the volatile underworld of the Valle Dorata, where loyalty is tested, debts are settled, and every move carries weight.

Continue Enzo's story across two new chapters, featuring fresh environments, weapons, vehicles, and Charms. In new DLC content for Free Ride mode, team up with Salieri to earn big by taking on a new set of exclusive jobs and extreme challenges, and discover new collectibles and hidden locations as you explore.

releases.name: Quiz Challenge Multiplayer
releases.summary: Quiz Challenge Multiplayer is the quiz game that turns your couch into a game show stage.Answer questions across two great fields of knowledge — History and Science — each split into a wide range of themes. From ancient civilizations to modern events, from astronomy to chemistry, every session mixes things up so no two games feel the same.GRAB A CONTROLLER, GRAB YOUR FRIENDSPlay solo to train at your own pace, or gather up to 4 players in local multiplayer. No account, no connection, no waiting — just pass the pad or take a controller each and start.TWO WAYS TO PLAYSTANDARD — Classic quiz rules. Take your time, think it through, and answer correctly to score.BATTLE — Speed is everything. The faster you lock in the right answer, the more points you take. Hesitate, and your opponents leave you behind.LEARN WHILE YOU PLAYEvery question is a chance to pick something new up. History and Science are only half of it: the game is fully playable in English, French, German and Spanish, so you can switch to the language you're learning and train your vocabulary while you play. It's a quiz night and a language lesson in one.FEATURESHundreds of questions across History and ScienceMultiple themes within each category1 to 4 players, local multiplayerStandard and Battle modes4 fully localized languages: English, French, German, SpanishPick up and play — perfect for family evenings and party sessionsHow much do you really know? Time to find out.

releases.name: Mafia: The Omerta Collection
releases.summary: Mafia: The Omertà Collection, includes. Mafia: The Old Country Definitive Edition, Mafia: Definitive Edition, Mafia II: Definitive Edition, and Mafia III: Definitive Edition.

releases.name: Defender of the Crown: The Legend Returns
releases.summary:
In the 1980s, Defender of the Crown helped define a new kind of cinematic strategy game. Now it returns, rebuilt for modern platforms and remastered with an entirely new way to play.

Conquer territories, raise armies, storm castles, and shift the balance of power. It's the Defender of the Crown you remember - just sharper, cleaner, and built for today.

releases.name: Pinball Action
releases.summary:
"PINBALL ACTION" is a pinball game released by TEHKAN (KOEI TECMO GAMES) in 1985.

Try to clear all the features on all four tables, switching between them over the game!

Use tricks to shake the tables, control the ball, and seize any chance at a win!

releases.name: Bootstrap Island
releases.summary:
Bootstrap Island is an intense, realistic VR survival game, inspired by "Robinson Crusoe".

As the sole survivor of a 17th-century shipwreck you must quickly learn and adapt to survive against vicious beasts, explore the island and improve your skills to discover the mysteries of the tropical island.

releases.name: Panzer Knights: Commander's Edition
releases.summary:
Take command of a German panzer platoon and lead your forces through the chaos of World War II in this gripping tank simulation that blends hardcore strategy with anime-inspired visuals. Engage in explosive third-person combat across the battlefields of Europe, where every round counts. Load specialized ammunition, target enemy weak points, and call in tactical support as you adapt to the ever-changing situation on the front line.

Between missions, assemble an elite tank crew by handpicking recruits with unique skills, and deploy a formidable arsenal of meticulously detailed tanks, each with their own characteristics, strengths, and vulnerabilities.

In a conflict where victory is achieved through cunning, adaptability, and precision, do you have what it takes to emerge triumphant?

releases.name: Cairn - On the Trail: Deep Water
releases.summary:
On the Trail is a series of free DLCs for the award winning survival climbing game Cairn. Set out on the ascent of a lifetime with pro-climber Aava: climb anywhere, plan your route carefully, and manage your resources to survive the unforgiving ascent of Mount Kami.

On the Trail brings climbers to new climbing locations and challenges. Find your route freely in the new spots, solve fresh climbing problems and explore iconic places as you follow the trail of a legendary climber.

On the Trail: Deep Water, the first of the series, brings you 3 new climbing spots, and introduces water soloing: you can now climb over water, without the consequences when falling!
